title: Latched alarm with acknowledgment and reannunciation

provenance.adaptation: Independently specified for this project; no public task was copied. The coding assistant chose the state variables, priority order and fixed scan traces, then reviewed the traces against a separate Python transition implementation.
provenance.rationale: A panel alarm retains the event after a fault clears, silences the horn after acknowledgment, and sounds again for a new fault edge.
provenance.review: Assistant consistency review of initialization, simultaneous commands, retained state and recovery boundaries; independent Python oracle checked against manual expected traces. Not an industrial safety certification or external expert review.

requirements: Initialize Alarm and Acknowledged FALSE and previous Fault FALSE. A Fault sets Alarm. A rising Fault also clears Acknowledged, taking priority over Ack on that scan. While Fault remains TRUE, Ack can set Acknowledged. When Fault is FALSE the alarm remains latched; Ack can acknowledge that retained alarm. Reset clears both values only when Fault is FALSE, taking priority over Ack then. A new Fault rising edge reannunciates even if an old alarm was already latched. Horn equals Alarm AND NOT Acknowledged. Always update the previous Fault sample.
scenario: A panel alarm retains the event after a fault clears, silences the horn after acknowledgment, and sounds again for a new fault edge.
scan_semantics: At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.
safety_priority: New fault edge reannunciates before Ack
Reset only clears when Fault is absent

ltl.explanation: Horn follows the latched acknowledgment state.
A present fault cannot be reset away.
Every new event annunciates despite simultaneous Ack.
Fault disappearance does not clear the visible alarm.

tests.purpose: Acknowledge, fault clear and new event
Present fault blocks reset; removed fault reset wins
